description: Every propositional formula with empty atom support is equivalent to \(\bot\) or \(\top\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atomless_constant.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms A = ∅) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.falsum ∨
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.verum
